text:
Maya: Heads up  GA signoff checklist draft below. We need explicit owners and 'go/no-go' criteria. Items: SLA metrics + exceptions, API freeze + diffs, docs quickstart + migration notes, support rota + escalation ladder, monitoring + alert thresholds, pricing tiers + intro discounts.
Ibrahim: I'll take SLA + perf guardrails. Proposal: Hosted SLA 99.9% uptime, p99 soft <=350ms, p99 hard <=650ms. Dedicated SLA 99.95%, p99 soft <=280ms, hard <=450ms. Include maintenance window policy.
Lina: Docs owner here. Need API freeze timestamp, list of deprecated params, and 3 short samples (python/js/curl). Will include a one-paragraph "what to expect at GA" and an "if things go wrong" snippet for Support.
Carlos: I'll handle monitoring and alerts. Dashboards: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/request cost, KV cache hit rate, GPU load. Alerts: p99>650ms, errors>1% sustained 5m, cost anomaly >30% 15m.
Sam: Pricing: recommend Dev (metered w/ free tier), Standard (metered + soft limits), Enterprise (committed + SLA). Suggest an intro 12-week discount for new GA signups. Need cost-per-token delta from Ibrahim.
Alex: Support/ops: propose 72-hour elevated staffing from GA start (2x normal coverage) with named rotation. Escalation ladder: SRE -> Eng oncall -> Product -> Exec for Sev1. I'll publish the rota and contact cards.
legal-bot: Ryan assigned to draft SLA appendix and pilot SOW. Will request product to mark any private-preview features that should be excluded.
Maya: Action matrix: SLA -> Ibrahim, Docs -> Lina, Monitoring -> Carlos, Pricing -> Sam, Support rota -> Alex, Legal wording -> Ryan. I'll open a GH issue with checklist and link owners.
Ibrahim: Running perf sweep Tue/ Wed. If p99 exceeds soft target, request permission for temporary capacity bump and an announcement to customers.
Lina: API freeze set to Fri EOD. I'll cut a delta doc showing parameter renames and sample migration steps.
Carlos: Will add a rollback playbook to the dashboard (how to switch model variant, drain region, enable autoscale).
Sam: Finance ask: confirm whether Dedicated GA customers get invoice-commitment vs metered billing. If committing, we'll need contract language for overage handling.
Alex: Also adding runbook links into the quickstart: incident triage, rollback, and customer communication templates.
Maya: Final sync Thurs 9am PT. If any owner can't meet deadlines, flag here. Deploy-bot: staging deploy (sha f9e7a1) passed e2e smoke.
Ibrahim: Perf logs will be linked to the GH checklist after tests.
Lina: I'll spin a docs PR draft today and tag reviewers.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll create the signoff issue and ping reviewers.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to prod-preview scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC.
